The remaining gap needs mesh separation (remeshing shell/limb volumes apart), out of scope for weight surgery. Do NOT present Gabu as passing 2.5.

known_history_and_deferred: Pass-1 bundle (Root strip + decontamination + flank unify + shell/spike rigid + buffers) REGRESSED all 6 p999 (attack 12.707, faint 22.466, hit 12.886, idle 2.526, ready 11.859, walk 8.397) and was REVERTED per Gate 3 (max improved on 4/6, but p999 is the gate). Pass-1 numbers are NOT the shipped numbers.

Pass-2 evolution: pass 2 (Root strip + reassignment + patches) fixed attack/faint/hit/ready but regressed idle (2.829) and walk (6.873) via a hard pure-vs-blend boundary inside the tail (foot/tail reassignment made tail verts pure while blended neighbours stayed mixed). Pass 2b (tail-zone decontamination: all tail-zone verts z<-0.55 & y<0.60 drop non-tail weights, 108176 verts, 3118 orphans all rescued to TailMid) fixed idle (1.629) and walk p999 (4.233). Pass 2c (groin patch) fixed the walk max edge (29.319 groin Hips-vs-UpLeg -> 9.147). 2c dominates 2b and was promoted.

Shell/spike rigid isolation: 0/1 creature in the final file — DEFERRED WITH EVIDENCE (pass-1 rigid was part of a regressing bundle and its isolated effect was never measured). Original pass-1 shell mask (tan AND torso-central, 641252 verts incl. dark extensions D1-D4) and spike mask (crown zone, 39400 verts) are recorded for the future isolated test.

Head-spike zone patch: NOT built — the guessed box (x ±0.70-1.15, y 1.35-1.70, z 0.25-0.65) came back EMPTY (0 verts). If spikes dominate a future gate, derive the box from that gate diag's exact endpoint positions.

Tail-base boundary edges (z -0.54, ratios 5.4-6.1 in walk 2b): present in the final weights as the price of tail-zone decontamination; at the TailMid pivot, acceptable. Do NOT smooth the base boundary (would reintroduce leg weights into the tail zone).
Belly-side dark verts (|x| 0.30-0.75, z>0.75, dark): in the final weights they ride smoothed belly-side patches (682/719 verts), not rigid. Targeted zone ONLY if previews/gates name them.

Tan verts on/near legs (shell-bottom vs leg scales): the final weights have NO shell rigid, so no leg is frozen to Chest; the walk side preview is the check for leg/shell-boundary appearance (clean apart from the shell-front/shoulder tear family).
Gabu flank unify slot-to-name mapping from pass 1 (slot vectors) is SUPERSEDED: the final weights use flank SMOOTHING, not unify. Do not assert slot names for the unify vectors.
Validate --clips stretch gate (slow pure-Python re-skin): NOT run on the final file (fastgate + stock attack cover stretch). Report as not run, not as passed.
